stories.headline: Analog Devices buys Alif for edge AI
stories.summary: Analog Devices agreed to buy Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion in cash, plus up to $200 million contingent. The deal combines ADI sensing and signal processing with Alif's low-power AI processors.

stories.headline: Suno launches licensed AI music models
stories.summary: Suno launched three AI music models with Warner Music and BMG, allowing generation inspired by licensed work from participating artists. Future artist-specific products will be opt-in, Suno says.

stories.headline: NATO allies foil Russian cable operation
stories.summary: Western officials told Reuters that Britain, Norway and the U.S. disrupted a Russian exercise near Svalbard involving technology designed to disable subsea cables. Russia did not comment; no cables were damaged.

stories.headline: Houthis seize strategic Yemeni port
stories.summary: Four Yemeni government military sources said Houthi forces seized Mocha and advanced toward the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. The development threatens another major shipping route as Hormuz traffic remains disrupted.

stories.headline: States challenge endangered-species rules
stories.summary: Twenty states and Washington, D.C., sued over federal rules narrowing habitat protections under the Endangered Species Act. The Interior Department says the revisions correct regulatory overreach.
